---
applyTo: 'packages/tokens/**,packages/tailwind/**'
---

# Tokens, themes and Tailwind

- `packages/tokens/src` is the single source of truth. Outputs (`tokens.css`, `tailwind-theme.css`,
  `tokens.json`, `native.js`) are generated by `scripts/build.mjs`; never edit `dist/`.
- Themes are declared with `defineTheme` in `src/themes.ts` (or with `npm run generate -- theme`).
  Choose seeds in OKLCH and a harmony; prefer overrides only when the generated value fails a check.
- Every theme must pass `validateTheme` (WCAG 2.2 AA, CVD distinguishability). The build fails
  otherwise; fix the generation or the seeds, never the thresholds.
- Semantic token names are shared by every theme (`src/types.ts`). Adding one means updating CSS,
  Tailwind, native and JSON outputs and their tests (`add-token` skill).
- The runtime (`src/runtime.ts`) must stay free of the color engine (no `culori` import).
- `packages/tailwind` only bundles the generated files; its test compiles real Tailwind CSS.
